parameters.query:
SELECT
    trip_id,
    url,
    trip_name,
    sku,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    category,
    type_of_slt,
    destination
FROM
    all_trips
WHERE
    CAST(start_date AS DATE) >= MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 9, 1)
  AND trip_name NOT ILIKE '%Test%'
ORDER BY
    start_date ASC;
